• It may not play properly

Older version detected

Replace mode carries a risk of corruption

Replace mode writes conversion results straight back to the original files; once overwritten, the originals cannot be recovered.

• If the app is interrupted, storage runs out, or permission is revoked while writing, the source files may be corrupted
• No conversion is guaranteed to succeed, and on failure the source files may already be unusable
• Try one or two files first to make sure everything is fine before processing in bulk
• Back up important photos yourself beforehand

This feature is provided “as is”; you use it at your own risk, and the author is not liable for corrupted or lost files.
